Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training process which conveys our value proposition, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Be able to accurately articulate Toptal’s value proposition and process.
  • Be able to speak to incoming leads, understand the clients’ needs, overcome any objections, present the value proposition of Toptal, and close leads that are a good fit for Toptal.
  • Work alongside the various business units to ensure your prospects are progressing through the funnel.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped up and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Possess a healthy pipeline of prospects that are working through your funnel.
  • Exhibit a successful track record of hitting sales goals.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Identify process improvement areas to help increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
  • Continue to implement sales best practices for client interactions and follow-up.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Continue to gain and close new business along with managing your funnel to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (i.e. Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/ leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Your Career

SASE is a significant source of revenue and growth at Palo Alto Networks. As a SASE Specialist, you drive the sale of the Palo Alto Networks SASE portfolio - to include Prisma Access, Prisma SD-Wan and Next Gen CASB across a broad geographic territory of Enterprise accounts. Additionally, you work with a variety of other teams to execute the overall SASE Go-to-Market plan, providing thought leadership and enabling scale. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical security challenges facing our customers.

You are required to exceed your quota, obtain/maintain subject matter expertise, create/update detailed written plans, and regularly present to a variety of audiences (large and small, live and virtual).

This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a strategic mindset to take a highly functioning business to the next level. This is not just a career – it’s a meaningful challenge that impacts our lives in the digital age.

Your Impact

  • Ability to work in partnership with your respective geography’s leadership to engage the SASE portfolio to customers, partners, and colleagues
  • Perform high-level sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business
  • Build a fundamental understanding of security threats, solutions, security tools or network technologies
  • Bring to bear all cross-functional resources to achieve your quota.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Conduct in-person sessions, webinars and learning materials that can be consumed by the appropriate audience
  • Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within accounts
  • Educate customers and partners on the modern network security landscape
  • Establish relationships with and sell through channel partners
  • Travel 50% + throughout the territory and to company-wide meetings

Your Experience

  • Consider yourself technical enough to cover some accounts while your SE is busy assisting others
  • Above quota sales experience in a high-tempo culture
  • Experience selling network infrastructure-based security appliances including, but not limited to - Firewalls, SSL/IPSec VPNs, Security Proxies and Caches, SD-WAN
  • Practical experience working with routing and switching products that will be installed adjacent to our appliances
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, both written and verbally
  • Experience working with Channel partners and understanding of a channel centric go to market approach
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Accountant will ensure the integrity of accounting and prepares accurate and timely financial statements and documents, in line with local GAAP and IFRS. Responsible for month end close activities; responsible for performing balance sheet, revenue, expense, and payroll account reconciliations, as well as executing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes. Assists with external audit, budgets and special projects as needed. To manage, supervising and motivate a small team of Accountants and provide effective guidance and leadership.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leading function in Month End and Year End closing activities.
  • Verifying and performing payments to suppliers & manage cash flow, and ensures all payments are properly approved prior payment.
  • To review transactions to assure accounting treatment is in accordance with IFRS and with internal accounting regulations.
  • To review general ledger accounts and makes necessary journal entries including posting monthly, quarterly and yearly accruals.
  • To prepare and record Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Fixed Assets entries by compiling and analysing account information.
  • To post payroll entries, to reconcile of social charges, bonus accrual and pay out.
  • To analyse and review company expenditures.
  • Produce error-free accounting reports and present their results.
  • Participate in financial standards setting and in forecast process.
  • Assist with tax audits, and tax returns and consumption tax returns.
  • Lead, plan, assign and review staff’s work.
  • Ensure compliance with IFRS and FIFA Accounting principles.
  • To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors.
  • To seek ways to improve upon accounting processes and procedures.
  • To assist the Head of Finance and the management on special requests.

YOUR PROFILE

Experience and qualifications

  • Degree in Accounting
  • Proven experience (4 years or more) as accounting supervisor and/or senior accountant
  • Experience in an international environment
  • Experience using/maintaining a financial ERP model (e.g. SAP)
  • Experience in Event Finance of advantage
  • Experience in procurement of advantage
  • Good communication skills, ability to communicate effectively in English (oral and written)
  • Very good sense for responsibility
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Focus on accuracy and timeliness, attention to detail
  • Confidentiality
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What We Offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Although after-hours escalations are rare, you would be expected to provide a phone number that you could be contacted on at any time of the day/night in the event of a production-impacting issue

description:
Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil

Sobre a oportunidade

1. INTRODUÇÃO E CONTEXTO
A ProVeg Brasil é uma organização dedicada à transformação do sistema alimentar global, visando um futuro mais sustentável para todos, por meio do incentivo de dietas baseadas em vegetais. Reconhecemos a urgência e a complexidade dos desafios ambientais que o Brasil enfrenta, especialmente no que tange ao desmatamento e suas interconexões com os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal.
O Brasil assumiu o compromisso de alcançar o desmatamento zero até 2030, uma meta fundamental para a conservação de biomas de importância global, como a Amazônia e o Cerrado, e para o cumprimento de suas obrigações climáticas internacionais. Neste cenário, a agropecuária é amplamente reconhecida como um dos principais vetores de mudança no uso da terra no país.
Diante da relevância estratégica deste tema, a ProVeg Brasil busca subsidiar suas ações de advocacy e formulação de políticas públicas com evidências científicas robustas.
IMPORTANTE: ESTA NÃO É UMA VAGA DE EMPREGO. EM VEZ DE SE CANDIDATAR ATRAVÉS DO NOSSO SITE, ENVIE SUA PROPOSTA PARA , CONFORME EXPLICADO NA PARTE INFERIOR DESTA PÁGINA.

Detalhes da posição

2. OBJETIVO GERAL
Selecionar a elaboração de uma pesquisa científica para investigar a relação entre o desmatamento no Brasil e os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal, buscando compreender os desafios e as possibilidades para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero no país.

Responsabilidades

3. ESCOPO DA PESQUISA / TEMAS DE INTERESSE
A pesquisa deverá abordar, de forma abrangente e crítica, os seguintes temas interligados:

  • Desmatamento e Pecuária: Análise da dinâmica e dos impactos da expansão da pecuária (bovina, suína, avícola e outras) e de monoculturas destinadas à alimentação animal sobre o desmatamento em biomas brasileiros, com especial atenção à Amazônia e ao Cerrado.
  • Cadeias de Suprimentos de Produtos de Origem Animal: Investigação do papel de todos os produtos de origem animal e de seus insumos (como a produção de grãos para ração animal, a exemplo da soja) na pressão sobre as florestas e vegetação nativa.
  • Avaliação de Soluções e Limitações: Exame aprofundado do alcance e das limitações de soluções propostas para a sustentabilidade da produção, como a pecuária regenerativa e a intensificação da produção, em relação às metas de desmatamento e à mitigação de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (incluindo o metano).
  • Padrões de Consumo e Produção: Análise dos níveis atuais de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal no Brasil, considerando tanto o mercado interno quanto as exportações, e suas implicações para o cenário de desmatamento. O estudo deverá explorar cenários e quantificar as transformações necessárias para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero.

Requisitos

4. RESULTADOS ESPERADOS / ENTREGAS
O trabalho contratado deverá resultar em:

  • Estudo Científico Detalhado: Um relatório de pesquisa completo, com metodologia clara, análise de dados e conclusões embasadas cientificamente. Espera-se que a versão final deste estudo tenha aproximadamente 25-30 páginas.
  • Policy Brief: Um documento conciso e direto, com recomendações estratégicas para guiar as ações de advocacy político da ProVeg Brasil junto a formuladores de políticas, setor privado e sociedade civil.

Mais informações

6. PÚBLICO-ALVO DA CHAMADA
Convidamos pessoas jurídicas (instituições de pesquisa, consultorias, universidades, etc.) com comprovada experiência e expertise nas áreas de desmatamento, sistemas alimentares, pecuária, sustentabilidade, economia ambiental e políticas públicas a submeterem suas propostas.

7. COLABORAÇÃO
A ProVeg Brasil está aberta a colaborar ativamente em todas as etapas do projeto, oferecendo suporte na elaboração do policy brief e na estratégia de divulgação dos resultados. A participação conjunta na publicização dos resultados será bem-vinda e poderá ser acordada.

SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Este é um banco de talentos para Psicopedagogo(a). Se você ama trabalhar como profissional dessa área, se comunica de forma clara e é uma pessoa proativa, não deixe de enviar seu currículo!

Como nosso Psicopedagogo(a), você cumpriria as seguintes atividades:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;

  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Recrutamento e Seleção | Recursos Humanos | Educação Corporativa | Treinamento e Desenvolvimento | Estágio | Bolsista de Inovação | Programa Trainee…

O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

Formação Acadêmica: Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma: Inglês - Nível avançado (leitura).

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade na busca por informações;
  • Capacidade de síntese e comunicação clara;
  • Interesse em inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Conhecimento em foresight estratégico;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (google sheets);

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Experiência em foresight estratégico na área;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de cosméticos;
  • Desejável experiência em interpretação de escrita científica;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (looker);
  • Comunicação;
  • Criatividade.
  • Capacidade analítica;

About us

We offer attractive compensation packages and plenty of opportunities to grow with us. Our team works toward common goals, and we value each member's contributions to our mission of continuous improvement and innovation.

About the role

Hello talented professionals! We’re expanding our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to apply. While specific positions may not be available immediately, we’re proactively building a network of qualified candidates for future paid partnerships.

If you’re passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you.

A 3D generalist is a multi-talented professional capable of managing various facets of the 3D production process, including modeling, texturing, lighting, rigging, animation, rendering, and compositing. They embody versatility, adaptability, and creativity, making them well-suited for diverse projects and genres.

Here's what you can expect

  • Profile preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made

We’re committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team and look forward to connecting with you throughout this process.

The Quest

  • Concept interpretation : Translate 2D concepts and references into high-quality 3D models or sculpts with fidelity to the original design while adding necessary details to achieve leveling, style and craftsmanship with minimal direction.
  • High poly modeling and sculpting : Use industry-standard software to create detailed models that tell a story and meet artistic and technical requirements for the project.
  • Low poly and mid poly creation : Create game-ready versions with optimized topology, efficient UVs, and meeting technical requirements.
  • Textures creation : Use Photoshop and Substance Painter to create high-quality texture maps that accurately represent materials and align with project style.
  • Rigging and animation support : Collaborate with animators and riggers to prepare models for animation, providing clean topology and rig-friendly meshes, and help integrate animations into the game engine.
  • Optimization and performance : Optimize assets for performance and memory usage, implementing LODs and other techniques.
  • Asset integration : Export assets and integrate them in a game engine.
  • Efficient time management : Work efficiently to meet phase timelines and delivery dates.
  • Teamwork : Collaborate with other artists to solve problems and communicate about quality, technical, or delivery issues.
  • Punctuality : Present progress daily and/or when requested, and assist in meetings as needed.

The Skills

About us

Amber, we're always on the hunt for the most talented individuals in the industry to join our team. We're dedicated to delivering top-notch service to our customers and know that our employees are key to making that happen. We offer attractive compensation packages and plenty of chances to grow with us, and we're always on the lookout for ways to do things better. Our team works together towards common goals and we value each member's contributions to our mission of continuous improvement and innovation.

About the role

Hello talented professionals! We're currently looking to expand our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to join us by applying to this job posting. While specific positions may not be available immediately, we're proactively building a network of qualified candidates for future paid partnerships. If you're passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you!

As a UI (User Interface) Artist, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces for mobile games and apps. You will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers to design, implement, and optimize UI elements that enhance the overall gameplay experience and engage players.

The purpose of the role is to conceptualize, mock-up, and execute interface designs across many different systems, creating a visual and functional connection between the user experience and the game story. You will work with us to design and develop user interface styles, structures and flows integrated in our projects, augmenting gameplay systems and complementing the established art direction.

What you can expect

  • Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values.
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will undergo an initial interview to discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role.
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment to demonstrate their abilities.
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made.

We're committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team, and we look forward to connecting with you throughout this exciting process.

The Quest

  • UI Design: Create concept sketches, wireframes, and mockups for various UI screens, including menus, HUDs (Heads-Up Displays), overlays, and interactive elements. Develop cohesive visual themes and styles that align with the game's aesthetic and target audience.
  • Graphic Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality UI assets, including icons, buttons, backgrounds, and visual effects. Use graphic design software to create scalable and visually appealing UI elements that enhance usability and accessibility.
  • Iconography and Typography: Select appropriate icons, symbols, and typography to convey information, enhance navigation, and communicate game mechanics effectively. Ensure consistency in iconography style, color schemes, and typography across all UI screens.
  • Animation and Motion Graphics: Implement animations and motion graphics to enhance interactivity, feedback, and visual interest within the UI. Create dynamic transitions, button animations, and visual effects that respond to player interactions and events.
  • User Experience (UX) Optimization: Conduct user research, playtesting, and usability testing to gather feedback and insights on UI design and functionality. Iterate on UI layouts, navigation flows, and interactive elements to improve user engagement, retention, and satisfaction.
  • Technical Implementation: Work closely with developers to integrate UI assets into the game engine (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and ensure optimal performance across various mobile devices and screen resolutions. Collaborate on UI scripting and implementation tasks as needed.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with game designers, artists, programmers, and producers to align UI design goals with gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, and technical constraints. Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to enhance the overall game experience.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and QA checks to ensure UI elements function as intended, adhere to design specifications, and meet performance targets. Identify and address any UI-related bugs, glitches, or usability issues in a timely manner.

The Skills

  • Strong understanding of design principles, color theory, typography, and composition. Ability to create visually appealing and cohesive UI designs that enhance usability and aesthetics.
  • Ability to bring static UI elements to life through dynamic animations and visual effects. Experience with animation software (e.g., After Effects, Spine) and a passion for creating engaging animations and motion graphics within UI.
  • User-Centered Design , knowledge of UX principles and methodologies, including user research, usability testing, and iterative design. Ability to empathize with users and advocate for their needs throughout the UI design process.
  • Best practices for designing UI interfaces for touchscreen devices. Experience with mobile game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) is a plus. Familiarity with mobile gaming industry and platform-specific UI/UX guidelines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey ideas, concepts, and feedback to cross-functional team members. Comfortable giving and receiving constructive criticism in a team-oriented environment.
  • Creative thinking and a passion for pushing the boundaries of UI design in mobile games. Ability to solve design challenges, iterate on ideas, and adapt to feedback and changing project requirements.

title: Senior product designer
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta. A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Sobre a área de Design

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

Como Senior Product Designer, você será peça-chave na criação de soluções centradas no usuário que traduzem problemas complexos em experiências intuitivas e funcionais.

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Ya viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para colaborar bem com desenvolvedores.

Temos diferentes frentes de atuação e, durante o processo, vamos buscar o melhor encaixe entre suas habilidades e os desafios da Lemon.

Experiência desejável

(não esperamos que você domine tudo valorizamos curiosidade e vontade de aprender)

  • Conhecimento em design comportamental e arquitetura da escolha;
  • Experiência na construção e evolução de Design Systems.

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dia de folga adicional próximo a feriados).

Leia aqui por favor

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade. Encorajamos que se candidatem pessoas com as mais diferentes histórias e vivências, pois isso nos auxilia a criar um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc. . This is a remote, flexible contract role (part-time, up to 25 hours weekly).

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with advanced medical training to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) in the medical microbiology domain. As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will evaluate AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or Ph.D. in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. Note: assessment is mandatory and non-billable

Bonus

title: Completion Engineer (Lower Completion Specialist)
description:
Overview

Focusing on lower completions, this position will plan, design, and execute lower completion and gravel pack operations, provide offshore technical supervision, coordinate with wells, subsurface, and operations teams, and ensure proper well closeout and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by Subsurface team
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly Budgets and well/project specific AFE's
  • Forecast and accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific Long Lead requirements
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination & quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required including conducting service quality meetings
  • Ensure Vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the Company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process so as to ensure timely action/close out
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required
  • Contributor to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS)
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, and execution and closeout activities
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied materials, equipment and services which includes review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and 3rd party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Design Reservoir Lower Completion for producer and injector wells across different assets within the company
  • Perform Torque & Drag analysis for deploying lower completions in long horizontal wells. Specify landing string and evaluate the requirement for swiveling devices
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team which includes lower completion sizing and design, GP pumping schedule, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities
  • Establish well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material & equipment selection
  • Identify special Engineering Studies to be performed
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and capable of presenting a succinct recommendation
  • Raise Requisitions & Purchase Orders
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services which includes but is not limited to review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Review all applicable operating, installing & testing procedures, including interface documents
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP as part of well/project commencement
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices
  • Review the engineering focussed After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt
  • Responsible for compilation of End of well Reports (EOWRs)

Education

  • Degree qualification in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage

Experience

  • Experience in Lower Completion and GP Pumping engineering
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution
  • Experience with Alternate Path GP pumping technology is considered an advantage
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages
  • Knowledge of GP pumping software PackPro or similar

title: Learning Coach
description:
Overview

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career. Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry. TripleTen is a remote-first organization, mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment.

Please submit all Resumes or CVs in English

What to Expect During the Application and Interview Process

  • Video Interview: As the second step, you’ll need to submit a short video interview where you\'ll answer four questions, with each response being 2 minutes or less. This will help us get to know you better.
  • Assessment Task: Next, you’ll complete a brief assessment, which will be the first step in the interview process, designed to help us evaluate some of the technical skills essential for this role. This assessment mirrors some of the common tasks you would be expected to perform in the role independently after your initial 2 weeks of training.
  • Interview with the Hiring Team: Candidates who successfully complete the first two stages will be invited to a final 30-45 minute interview with our hiring team. This interview is specifically designed to answer any questions you may still have about the position, and provide clarity on the day-to-day responsibilities. We will also cover a few behavioral based interview questions to assess culture and work style fit.

All stages of the process will be conducted in English.

What you will do

  • Build strong 1:1 relationships with assigned students
  • Proactively coach students on motivation, time management, and study strategies
  • Help students navigate barriers to success and refer at-risk learners for support
  • Track student progress and flag disengagement in Planhat
  • Participate in live events and sprint launches when assigned
  • Keep documentation up-to-date for all student interactions
  • Submit reports, metrics, and trends as requested by Program Lead
  • Collaborate with peers for shift coverage, cross-support, and best practices

Requirements

Schedule

  • Monday - Thursday 9:00 am - 5:00 pm (Any US Time Zone)
  • Friday 9:00 am - 4:00 pm (Any US Time Zone)
  • Maintain timely responses: within 2 hours during active windows
  • You’re fluent in English - our students are Americans, many of our team members are natives, so it’s necessary to speak fluently.
  • You’re a fast learner - we conduct a lot of experiments, often change our processes, it’s okay not to know something but it’s necessary to learn and adapt fast.
  • You’re careful with numbers and analytics (Excel, Notion, Miro) - a Learning Coach calculates some statistics and collects certain data manually. It requires patience and attention to numbers.
  • You love helping and caring about people - our Learning Coaches are always there to help our students, check up on their motivation and ask for their feedback.
  • You thrive in a fast changing environment and are good at lateral problem solving.
  • You have a laptop capable of efficiently running our main work tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Discord, Planhat CRM, LMS, etc.), a reliable internet connection (minimum speed of 20 Mbps for download and 5 Mbps for upload), and earphones to ensure high audio quality.

What we can offer you

  • $1000 Gross per month, with the ability to earn up to $1300 in monthly bonuses (KPI based)
  • Full-time remote contract-based collaboration;
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Miro, Notion, Google Meet, etc.— to make the process of working together seamless.
  • Diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across US, Serbia, Georgia, Armenia, Latin America and more.

Disclosures

  • At this time we are unable to offer H1B sponsorship opportunities in the USA.

description:

Para isso, você irá liderar iniciativas que envolvem:

Principais atribuições:

  • Criar e priorizar o roadmap da régua de comunicação para as jornadas de pós-vendas, alinhando objetivos do negócio com a experiência do cliente;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para alinhar necessidades de negócio (output metrics) com iniciativas de produto, priorizando entregas que gerem impacto estratégico;

  • 2. Liderar um Squad Multidisciplinar

    • Garantir a autonomia do Squad para tomada de decisões dentro das regras e constraints alinhadas à estratégia do negócio;
    • Participar ativamente dos rituais com os times de engenharia: daily, refinement, planning e retro/review
    • Gerenciar o Product Backlog: realizar a engenharia de histórias e features e guiar o time de engenharia na construção do produto. Sim, nós usamos JIRA mas valorizamos as conversas diretas!
    • Criar e zelar pela manutenção e precisão das documentações de produto;
  • 3. Desenvolver e Operar Ferramentas de Comunicação
    • Liderar o desenvolvimento de ferramentas proprietárias para comunicação com clientes, com foco em eficiência, escalabilidade e personalização;
    • Integrar e otimizar o uso de softwares de mercado (como CRM e ferramentas de automação de marketing);
  • 4. Personalização e Automação com Dados e IA
    • Coordenar, junto com o time de dados e analytics a aplicação de inteligência artificial e modelos de dados para personalizar mensagens e jornadas, aumentando a relevância e engajamento das comunicações;
  • 5. Analisar e Melhorar as Jornadas de Pós-Vendas
    • Mapear e otimizar pontos de contato em jornadas como entrega, montagem, troca, devolução e suporte, garantindo clareza e eficiência nas interações;
    • Monitorar indicadores de performance (NPS, engajamento, taxa de resolução, etc.) e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • 6. Colaborar com Stakeholders Internos e Externos
    • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas (operações, atendimento, marketing, dados) para alinhar iniciativas e garantir uma visão integrada do cliente;
  • 7. Garantir a Experiência do Cliente no Pós-Vendas
    • Observar constantemente o comportamento e o feedback dos clientes para identificar melhorias e oportunidades;
    • Testar e validar novas ideias, iterando rapidamente para melhorar a experiência em comunicação;
  • 8. Promover a Cultura de Obsessão pelo Cliente
    • Ser um defensor da experiência do cliente em todas as decisões do Squad, garantindo que as soluções entreguem valor real e a melhor experiência;

Essa posição é ideal para quem quer liderar iniciativas de alto impacto, combinando estratégia, inovação e um olhar atento às necessidades do cliente!

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) e frameworks de gestão de produto (OKRs, Roadmaps, Discovery e Delivery).
  • Experiência em priorização de backlog e definição de escopo com base em dados e objetivos estratégicos.
  • Ferramentas de Comunicação e CRM

    • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de marketing e régua de comunicação, como Insider, Braze, Customer.io ou similares.
  • Análise de Dados e Métricas

  • Desenvolvimento e Integração de Ferramentas

    • Entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas para colaborar com equipes de tecnologia.

  • Experience collaborating closely with Marketing and Customer Success to accelerate growth.
  • A leadership style that balances data-driven analysis with people development — bringing coaching, mentorship, and empowerment to the team.

Overview

Área: Qualidade de Software. A área é peça-chave na entrega de produtos robustos, confiáveis e com altíssima performance. A missão é apoiar todas as tribos e squads no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, promovendo uma experiência fluida e segura para usuários finais ou stakeholders internos.

Código da vaga: A

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Responsibilities

  • Promover excelência nas entregas de software por meio da definição, padronização e evolução contínua de processos e ferramentas de QA;
  • Atuar como liderança técnica em estratégias de testes, automação, observabilidade de qualidade, testes de performance e validação de sistemas críticos;
  • Desenvolver serviços e ferramentas dedicados ao processo de Qualidade de Software;
  • Conduzir PoCs com agentes de IA e ferramentas emergentes, explorando sua aplicação em tarefas de QA e validação inteligente;
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, projetos de engenharia da qualidade e integração com pipelines CI/CD;
  • Fomentar uma cultura sólida de qualidade por meio de treinamentos, mentorias técnicas e evangelização de boas práticas junto aos times de engenharia.

Atividades que você vai protagonizar

  • Conduzir discoveries técnicos, benchmarks e provas de conceito (PoCs) voltadas à evolução das práticas, ferramentas e soluções inteligentes para QA;
  • Traduzir iniciativas e ferramentas para desdobramento aos demais QAs;
  • Apoio direto no desdobramento e acompanhamento de indicadores do time de QA;
  • Mentorar e apoiar a evolução técnica de profissionais de QA, disseminando boas práticas de engenharia de testes e automação;
  • Propor, desenvolver e manter serviços auxiliares para compor o fluxo de QA;
  • Explorar, testar e integrar agentes de IA para identificação de padrões, geração de casos de teste, automação, análise de falhas ou priorização de testes;
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de estratégias de testes, cobertura, qualidade de código e gates em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Construir e manter pipelines de testes integradas ao processo de entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados, manuais e de performance, garantindo a confiabilidade e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Analisar funcionalidades e riscos técnicos para elaboração de planos de testes eficazes, cobrindo múltiplos níveis de validação;
  • Atuar com times de engenharia em processos de troubleshooting e debugging, com foco na rastreabilidade e mitigação de falhas.

Requisitos e habilidades técnicas

  • Domínio em automação de testes (UI, API, mobile, integração, etc.), com experiência prática em Cypress, Appium, Selenium e Postman;
  • Experiência em integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD), utilizando ferramentas como GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares;
  • Conhecimento avançado em engenharia e arquitetura de software, com foco em escalabilidade, testabilidade e manutenibilidade de sistemas;
  • Programação de sistemas com habilidade para construir serviços auxiliares e ferramentas dedicadas a testes;
  • Conhecimento em análise de qualidade de código utilizando SonarQube, SonarCloud ou outras ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência prática com a criação e uso de agentes de Inteligência Artificial aplicados a testes, como geração de casos, análise preditiva ou testes autônomos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (ex PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (ex MongoDB, DynamoDB);
  • Capacidade de executar e interpretar testes de performance (stress, carga, pico), com domínio de ferramentas como JMeter, K6 e soluções em nuvem (IaaS);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade, como NewRelic, Grafana, CloudWatch (AWS);
  • Familiaridade com Jira e Confluence para gestão de tarefas, bugs, documentações e estratégias de testes;
  • Experiência sólida em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com atuação ativa em cerimônias e entregas iterativas;
  • Prática com controle de versão e repositórios Git, seguindo boas práticas de branching e code review.

Perfil comportamental

  • Comunicação clara e eficaz com múltiplos públicos (Dev, Produto, Plataforma, Diretoria);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e de antecipação de riscos;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de dono;
  • Resiliência para lidar com mudanças e resolver problemas com agilidade;
  • Capacidade de mentorar e desenvolver colegas de equipe.

Formação

  • Superior completo em áreas de tecnologia/gestão tecnologia ou correlatas.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, Golang, NodeJS ou PHP, com foco em automação e serviços de suporte ao QA;
  • Experiência com frameworks alternativos de automação, como Playwright e Robot Framework;
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), incluindo deploys, containers, pipelines e serviços gerenciados;
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta criticidade e grande escala, com atenção a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Participação ativa em culturas de observabilidade, com uso estruturado de logs, métricas, alertas e dashboards;
  • Certificações em QA, Agile Testing ou automação de testes;
  • Pós-Graduação em Qualidade de Software ou áreas correlatas.
